exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: He is sure that he will come.
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.why: **выйти / выходить** — to exit, to go out; to appear, to be published; to spend, to be used up; to come off, to come out. — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: выйти / выходить — to exit, to go out; to appear, to be published; to spend, to be used up; to come off, to come out.

exercises.why: В прошлом году здесь провели несколько новых дорог.* Notice also the following expressions: Прошла неделя. — A week went by. Дождь прошёл. — The rain stopped. Other meanings from the prefix table: вы- — Step out for a short period of time: Секретарь вышел на десять минут. — The secretary left for ten minutes. под- — Подвезти – give someone a lift: Он подвёз меня до центра. — He took me (as far as) downtown. от- — With transitive verbs, delivering or dropping something off (agent does not remain): Я отнесу книги в библиотеку, потом приду. — I'll drop the book off at the library, then come. до- — Characterizing the duration of a journey, especially when it is long: Мы наконец доехали до дачи. — We finally reached the dacha. пере- — Changing residence: Я переехала в другой город. — I moved to another city. про- — Movement beyond one's destination (possibly unintentional): Я боюсь, что мы уже прошли магазин. — I'm afraid we already passed the store. на- — Quantified movement: Водитель наездил 50 километров. — The driver covered 50 kilometers.* — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Did you have a good time in Vegas?
exercises.context: В прошлом году здесь провели несколько новых дорог.

exercises.why: **завести / заводить** — to take, to bring, to lead; to get, to procure, to acquire, to buy; to establish, to set up, to found; to start. **нанести / наносить** — to drift (on); to carry, to waft, to deposit, to wash ashore (e.g. of snow, sand, etc.); to mark (on); to draw (e.g. onto a map); to inflict (on); to cause (to); to bring. **сойти / сходить** — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; (figuratively) to come off, to disappear, to go from; to pass by; (figuratively) to pass for, to be taken for. — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: завести / заводить — to take, to bring, to lead; to get, to procure, to acquire, to buy; to establish, to set up, to found; to start.

exercises.why: **обойтись / обходиться** — to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area); to overtake, to outrank, to beat, to outperform (a peer or competitor). **выйти / выходить** — to exit, to go out; to appear, to be published; to spend, to be used up; to come off, to come out. — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: We have walked all around the lake.
exercises.context: обойтись / обходиться — to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area); to overtake, to outrank, to beat, to outperform (a peer or competitor).
